text_block_list.name: A Certain History Column
text_block_list.text:
Grand yet light footsteps brushed past. 
Carrying the scent of turf, silver threads 
fluttered and sparkled.

text_block_list.name: A Certain History Column
text_block_list.text:
Her stride stretches out further and 
further, as if she could keep running 
endlessly, all the way to the edge of 
dreams.

text_block_list.name: A Certain History Column
text_block_list.text:
"Those who dared to dream at the sight of 
her receding back had their hearts 
captivated by her, without exception—"

One day, Gran Alegria called for me, and I 
went to the cafeteria together with Chrono 
Genesis—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Chrono-chan, Trainer-san! Congrats on 
running in the Takarazuka Kinen!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
A proud single-digit rank in the fan vote! 
I easily made the roster♪ So, it's time to 
celebrate!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: "W-Wah...! Just for me, really...?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Because it was your long-cherished dream, 
wasn't it? To be chosen near the top of 
the fan vote and run in the Grand Prix."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Didn't we all make a promise after last 
year's Tenno Sho (Autumn)?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
That by mastering our own paths, all of us 
together will surpass Ms. Eye.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Chrono-chan wants back-to-back Grand Prix 
victories. A win delivered through a run 
that moves the fans."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"You've taken that very first step toward 
it, after all. We've gotta celebrate 
this♪"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: B-But... I haven't even won yet...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
In fan voting, it's hard to get selected 
through your own efforts alone— so I 
actually think it's quite a difficult 
feat.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
It's a celebration, after all. Let's hit 
60 miles and party hard!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Chrono-san doesn't just polish her 
running— she brings so much excitement to 
the Grand Prix fan voting.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
You have also achieved the goal of being 
selected yourself.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
You did so much, like publishing columns 
externally and setting up exhibitions! I'm 
seriously impressed!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Out of all of us, Chrono-chan is the only 
one running in the Takarazuka Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
As a representative of our generation... 
—you'd better show everyone what you're 
made of!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"We're also... walking our own paths. I'm 
thinking of honing my tenacity... over 
longer distances."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
It's still just the preparation phase, but 
I've begun training in anticipation of an 
overseas expedition.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Winning titles across two categories—the 
mile and sprints! I'm just one step away, 
so I'm definitely winning this autumn! And 
after that, I'm sprinting all the way to a 
triple crown across three divisions!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
All of us will master our own paths... and 
build a generation that belongs only to 
us...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
That's right. I'm counting on you for the 
Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! I have received your 
encouragement, loud and clear...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, we haven't made chocolate carrots 
yet! Alright everyone, get ready~"

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text:
Chrono-chan, you're definitely winning the 
Takarazuka Kinen! Give it your all!!

The spring Grand Prix, the Takarazuka 
Kinen, was overflowing with the eager 
cheers of hopeful fans.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I really want Lucky Lilac to win, since I 
voted for her!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"I'm all for Chrono Genesis! I got 
interested after reading a history column 
and started following her, and man, 
watching her run feels amazing!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
When you have an Umamusume you're rooting 
for, your heart pounds just like it's 
happening to you! I'm so glad I voted for 
her!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...A rematch with Lala-san and Blast-san, 
whom I ran with in the Osaka Hai..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Holding Grass-san's teachings in my 
heart... I intend to face it head-on...!
choice_data_list:
Show them the strength of our generation 
with your running!

Let's show off our generation's strength 
with your running!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes... For the sake of the fans who voted 
for me, too—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I'll run in a way that makes everyone 
feel... glad they supported me...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"Chrono-chaaan! Do your best~! I'm reading 
your column too!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Chrono's a bit spaced out, which makes 
her cute. It kinda makes you want to cheer 
her on."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(Wah...! C-Could it be, those are the 
people who voted for me in the fan 
poll...?!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(I'm so happy... What do I do? I'm just so 
happy...!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (—Oops, I must not let my heart waver.)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (――Grant me a calm mind...)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(Tea ceremony is tranquil, yet one must 
pay attention to every detail and respond 
with flexibility...)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(Observe and memorize the surroundings. 
...Yet keep my heart completely calm.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...! ...Oh my, good heavens...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Chrono-chan... What in the world have you 
been up to?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (...I won't be shaken. This time, yes...)
Chrono Genesis turned her gaze toward me.
choice_data_list:
(So that's how you stir up fighting 
spirit!)

(So that's how you stir up fighting 
spirit!)

text_block_list.text:
I clench my fist and give a firm nod. 
"Win, and carve your hoofprints into 
history!" —pouring that sentiment into the 
gesture.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(In the Grand Prix... I will leave my 
hoofprints!)

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Heh... heheheh! A spark of electricity 
just zapped right through me...!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
It feels like I'm facing off against a 
small yet brave watchdog...!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: I'm not letting my guard down!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...I suppose so.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I suppose I'll... give it my 
all too.
